This permanently deletes your ACOMI login and personal account information (name, mobile number, email, address, photo, and uploaded identity documents).

You will be signed out and will not be able to use this account again.

Property records such as spaces, rooms, occupancy, meals, payments, and complaints stay with the business. Your personal details on those records are removed or replaced with a generic deleted-user label. Your memberships are removed.
